description: Recorded memory retrieval eval fixture from the Claude Code Insights report and sampled claude-mem failures for the May 28-30 tsift/agent-doc workflow. The fixture compares raw claude-mem API retrieval, tsift session-review/context-pack handoff retrieval, and graph-db related retrieval on useful hits, output tokens, latency, and zero-output failures.

tasks.label: Recover the observer memory prompt-too-long failure class
tasks.target: Claude Code Insights report: observer/memory sessions with context-overflow and Prompt is too long failures

runs.notes: Sampled claude-mem search returned no usable observer-overflow row for the prompt-too-long query.
session-review --next-context plus context-pack surfaced prompt-size failures, restart churn, and handoff commands.
graph-db related recovered semantic rows and source handles with the lowest result budget.

tasks.label: Find the tsift-owned budget guard that prevents oversized memory prompts
tasks.target: tsift memory budget-guard and query-plan contract

runs.notes: claude-mem history could identify memory entries but not the tsift budget contract.
session-review/context-pack carried the budget-guard backlog and verification context.
graph-db related ranked the memory budget contract and its source handles together.

tasks.label: Retrieve imported claude-mem observations linked into graph memory
tasks.target: sampled claude-mem observation and investigation rows projected as source_handle and semantic_concept nodes

runs.notes: Sampled API query missed the graph memory adapter observation despite the local database containing matching rows.
context-pack identified the adapter work and source windows but returned broader session context.
graph-db related returned imported claude-mem source handles plus the semantic concept rows.

tasks.label: Recover session-review evidence for restart churn and no-op closeouts
tasks.target: Claude Code Insights report plus tsift session-review next-context closeout diagnostics

runs.notes: Sampled claude-mem query returned no usable restart/no-op closeout evidence row.
session-review/context-pack directly surfaced restart churn, no-op closeouts, and closeout commands.
graph-db related recovered the backlog/source handles but less of the time-ordered closeout narrative.
